name: indigokit
description: IndigoKit — Bootstrap-first Enterprise UI Kit. Bootstrap's familiar API with a refined visual system, light/dark themes, measured accessibility, and a reusable application shell.

scripts.build:css: sass --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import --silence-deprecation=global-builtin --silence-deprecation=if-function --silence-deprecation=color-functions src/scss/indigokit.scss dist/css/indigokit.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import --silence-deprecation=global-builtin --silence-deprecation=if-function --silence-deprecation=color-functions src/scss/indigokit.scss dist/css/indigokit.min.css && sass --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import --silence-deprecation=global-builtin --silence-deprecation=if-function --silence-deprecation=color-functions src/scss/indigokit-select2.scss dist/css/indigokit-select2.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map --load-path=node_modules --silence-deprecation=import --silence-deprecation=global-builtin --silence-deprecation=if-function --silence-deprecation=color-functions src/scss/indigokit-select2.scss dist/css/indigokit-select2.min.css
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.test: echo "No test runner — the build + playground QA are the release gates (see AGENT_KNOWLEDGE, Task 056)." && exit 0
